message.content:
Based on the search results, here are the steps to log into OneDrive:

## Web Browser (OneDrive Web Version)

1. **Open your browser** (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, etc.)
2. **Go to the official OneDrive website**: https://onedrive.live.com/login/
3. **Click the Sign in button** (usually in the top right corner)
4. **Enter your Microsoft account email address** and click Next
5. **Enter your password** and click Sign in
6. If you have two-factor authentication enabled, complete the verification step

## OneDrive Desktop App (Windows)

1. **Open OneDrive**:
   - Click the Start menu and search for "OneDrive", or
   - Click the OneDrive cloud icon in your taskbar (near the clock)
2. **Enter your Microsoft Account email address** when prompted
3. **Enter your password**
4. **Choose your sync folder location** (or keep the default)
5. Click **Next/Sign in** to complete setup

## Important Notes

- You need a **Microsoft account** to use OneDrive (Outlook, Hotmail, Xbox, or work/school account)
- If you don't have an account, click "Create one" on the login page to register
- OneDrive supports **one personal account + one or more work/school accounts** on the same PC
- To add a second account: Click OneDrive icon → Settings → Account → Add an account
